tickets.subject: Checkout throws a 500
tickets.body: Since this morning our checkout throws a 500 on the confirm step. Chrome 126 on Windows. Error code PAY-5012 in the console.

tickets.subject: Can't complete my purchase
tickets.body: I add everything to the cart, hit the final button, and it just spins forever. Order was around $2,400. Tried twice.

tickets.subject: Payment page is blank
tickets.body: The payment page loads completely white. Nothing to click. Started today, worked fine last week. We're on the enterprise plan.

tickets.subject: Orders over ~$2k failing
tickets.body: Smaller test orders go through, but anything above roughly $2,000 fails at confirmation. Reproduced three times.

tickets.subject: Export never finishes
tickets.body: Exporting last quarter's data as CSV just hangs at 90%. Smaller ranges work.

tickets.subject: Reset email takes hours
tickets.body: A colleague in our Berlin office requested a password reset at 9am and the email arrived after lunch.

tickets.subject: Empty dashboard
tickets.body: All the charts on the analytics dashboard are blank rectangles. Safari 18 on macOS. Fine in Chrome.

tickets.subject: Question about invoicing
tickets.body: How do I change the billing contact on our account?

tickets.subject: Feature request: dark mode
tickets.body: Any chance of a dark theme? Half my team asks about it.
